svg.title: NET-10-U — Failed session refresh
svg.desc: Actual failed refresh after populated selected results. Unchanged geometry. The grey noninteractive list replacement hides cached rows and selected identity, endpoint, and mode details. One complete black error line, Refresh focused, every browser join disabled.

g.text: Directory unavailable. Direct connection and local play are still available.
Refresh successfully before joining. Availability unconfirmed.
LAN-first. A listing does not guarantee reachability.
One full error line; no headings, dividers, white rows, scrollbar, or row input.
Cached rows and selected identity/endpoint/mode hidden. Refresh focused.
Recovery restores retained identity only if present, never another session.
Status and paging allocations stay reserved; conditional paging group unchanged.
